features.title: Teal navy and charcoal page background
features.meaning: The gradient variable defines the colors. The body rules apply it across pages and the homepage. The older black variable in styles.css is not the current body background.
features.mission: A consistent dark background supports reading the controls; it does not detect danger.

features.title: Dark cards and borders
features.meaning: The shared selector targets tool cards. The homepage rule supplies charcoal fill, a thin gray border and padding around each choice.
features.mission: Separates actions visually so a person can find the next step.

records.code: .choice-card { background: #202122; border: 1px solid #54595d; padding: 22px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }

features.title: Body text and serif headings
features.meaning: System fonts display body text; Georgia displays headings. The heading rule uses medium weight and tighter spacing.
features.mission: Readable hierarchy supports quick scanning during a check-in.

records.code: h1, h2, h3 { font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.018em !important; }

features.title: Readable shared page width
features.meaning: The shared rule caps these containers at 960 pixels and leaves 40 pixels of viewport space. Homepage styles.css later sets its container width separately.
features.mission: Keeps the interface within the screen and avoids overly long reading lines.

features.title: Homepage content width
features.meaning: The homepage container can grow to 1180 pixels while retaining 16-pixel side margins on a narrow screen.
features.mission: Uses the available screen while keeping content away from its edges.

features.title: Main and secondary buttons
features.meaning: Primary actions use blue with white text; secondary actions use charcoal and a gray border. Later rules override the old white primary-button fill.
features.mission: Makes the principal action easier to distinguish.

features.title: Emergency choice accent
features.meaning: The emergency color variable supplies the red upper border on the immediate-danger card.
features.mission: Visually distinguishes the manual emergency choice from general support.

features.title: Mobile cards and sequence layout
features.meaning: At 800 pixels or narrower, the three listed grids become single columns. This rule does not change the separate hero grid.
features.mission: Keeps important choices readable on a phone.

features.title: Mobile navigation and map size
features.meaning: Navigation can scroll horizontally on narrow screens. The satellite map becomes 280 pixels tall below 600 pixels.
features.mission: Preserves navigation and location context on smaller displays.

records.code: .site-nav .groups { overflow-x: auto; flex-wrap: nowrap; width: 100%; padding-bottom: 4px; }

features.title: Keyboard focus and skip link
features.meaning: The focus rule draws an outline. The skip link jumps to main content and becomes visible when focused.
features.mission: Lets keyboard users reach and operate the safety controls.

features.title: Responsive browser viewport
features.meaning: The viewport meta tag tells the browser to use the device width and an initial scale of one.
features.mission: Allows responsive CSS to use the actual phone viewport.

features.title: Dialog overlay and readable controls
features.meaning: The care dialog has a bounded width and internal padding. The account backdrop dims the page behind its modal.
features.mission: Keeps a prompt distinct from the surrounding page.

features.title: naloxones row typography and spacing
features.meaning: Venue links are bold; addresses, indoor hints and metadata appear on separate muted lines.
features.mission: Helps someone identify the destination before reading the final directions.

features.title: Home tracker and About navigation

features.mission: Provides consistent routes to the core monitoring flow.

features.title: PulseGuard brand and active page
features.meaning: The brand is inserted as text. The matching navigation link is marked as the current page for assistive technology.
features.mission: Makes the service and the current location within it identifiable.

features.mission: Keeps navigation available after a person reaches the end of a page.

features.title: Labels for supporting experiments

features.title: Click and hover feedback

features.title: Hover throttling and touch behavior
features.meaning: Hover sounds are limited to mouse events and spaced by at least 120 milliseconds. Touch does not get an extra hover sound.
features.mission: Reduces distracting repeated feedback.

features.title: Remembered sound preference
features.meaning: The toggle saves the ordinary click-sound preference in the browser. It does not mute the separate warning media element.
features.mission: Gives users control over routine feedback while preserving the warning flow.

features.meaning: Squaring and summing the three axes produces acceleration magnitude including gravity. The threshold is 25 metres per second squared.
features.mission: Recognizes a possible drop, without determining whether a person collapsed.
